notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Removals, review problems, warnings, points, mutes, honors, replies, and mentions show up here.

wish.hoursHint: Up to 24 hours. After that it leaves the wish list.
wish.badHours: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 24
wish.saleEmpty: No sales yet. Post one to start.
